items.story:
We keep our 2026E EPS roughly unchanged but lift 2027-28E EPS by 7-8%,
mainly to reflect higher sales, driven by AI chassis and rack business, better operating
leverage, and 2Q26 actual numbers. We cut our PO to NT$1,305 (19x 2027E
EPS) from NT$1,600 (25x 2027E EPS), with a lower target P/E multiple though the
valuation base stays unchanged. We lower the target P/E multiple to 19x (around 2.5SD
above average) from 25x (4SD above) for solid AI momentum but potentially
limited GM increase vs. expanding OPM. We reiterate Buy on Chenbro, given exposure to
GPU and ASIC to ride on AI server upcycle with content/value growth.

items.story:
研究部給予達運光電逢低買進評等：1) 軍工智慧聯網訂單能
見度延伸，提供中期成長基礎；2) 北美寬頻設備進入下一輪升級週期，2027
年有望迎來較明顯復甦；3) 產品組合改善搭配營運槓桿，獲利成長幅度有
望優於營收。研究部預估2027 年營收為24.10 億元，YoY +24.7%，毛利
率34.6%，營益率13.0%，稅後淨利2.62 億元，YoY +198.6%，EPS2.76
元。給予逢低評等，目標價63 元（23x 2027EPS）。
